# Code of Conduct

This project follows the [Contributor Covenant](https://www.contributor-covenant.org/version/2/1/code_of_conduct/),
version 2.1. In short:

## Our pledge

We want participation in SAKER to be a harassment-free experience for everyone, regardless of
age, body size, visible or invisible disability, ethnicity, sex characteristics, gender identity and
expression, level of experience, education, socio-economic status, nationality, personal appearance,
race, caste, colour, religion, or sexual identity and orientation.

## Expected behaviour

- Be respectful and considerate, and assume good intent.
- Give and accept constructive feedback gracefully.
- Focus on what is best for the project and its users.
- Take responsibility for mistakes and learn from them.

## Unacceptable behaviour

- Harassment, insults, or derogatory comments, in public or in private.
- Sexualised language or imagery, and unwelcome attention of any kind.
- Publishing other people's private information (phone numbers, addresses, wallet keys) without
  their explicit permission.
- Any other conduct that would reasonably be considered inappropriate in a professional setting.

## Scope

This Code of Conduct applies in all project spaces (issues, pull requests, discussions and reviews)
and when someone officially represents the project elsewhere.

## Reporting and enforcement

Report unacceptable behaviour to the maintainer, [Atharv Chaskar](https://github.com/Atharvchaskar008),
through the contact options on their GitHub profile. Reports are handled promptly and confidentially.
The maintainer may remove, edit or reject contributions that violate this Code of Conduct and may
temporarily or permanently ban contributors whose behaviour is harmful.

Security vulnerabilities are not conduct issues: report them privately as described in
[SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md).
